description: SUMO2Unity provides a co-simulation tool connecting SUMO traffic simulation with Unity scenes. The provider is SimuTraffX-Lab (repository owner). Geographical and temporal coverage: The project provides setup guides, demonstrations and research examples for traffic-safety simulation. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): MIT (code); CC-BY (assets). The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: Unity and third-party assets have separate terms. No co-simulation session was run. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-sumo, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
